AboutPage.title: About Omni Search Dashboard
AboutPage.subtitle: PROJECT DOCUMENTATION & VISION
AboutPage.section1Title: A Single Page Experience for Gaming Enthusiasts
AboutPage.section1Text: Omni Search Dashboard is a sophisticated SPA meticulously crafted for searching and exploring video games. By leveraging the powerful RAWG API, it provides real-time access to a vast database of titles, genres, and publishers within a high-performance, ethereal interface.
AboutPage.section2Text: The codebase is organized following the Feature-Sliced Design (FSD) methodology. This architectural pattern ensures scalability and maintainability by decomposing the application into distinct, loosely coupled layers, slices, and segments.
